Simple random sampling

Source: R/design-simple.R
design_simple.Rd

Draws n rows uniformly at random.

Usage

design_simple(n, replace = FALSE)

Arguments

n

Number of rows to draw. A single non-negative whole number.

replace

Sample with replacement? Note that draw(weights = TRUE) declines a with-replacement design: .prob would be the chance of appearing at least once, which does not weight a sample holding duplicates. See draw().

Value

A design object, for use with draw().

See also

draw()

Other designs: design_bootstrap(), design_certainty(), design_cluster(), design_multistage(), design_reservoir(), design_spatial(), design_stratified(), design_systematic(), design_temporal(), design_weighted()

Examples

df <- data.frame(id = 1:100)
draw(df, design_simple(n = 10), seed = 1)
#>    id
#> 1  68
#> 2  39
#> 3   1
#> 4  34
#> 5  87
#> 6  43
#> 7  14
#> 8  82
#> 9  59
#> 10 51
draw(df, design_simple(n = 150, replace = TRUE), seed = 1)
